metadata.description: johnnyvizz's public Claude Code skills and mods.

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: Skill: plan, delegate to tiered worker subagents, review.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Mod: progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel; made for savvy-flow, shows any subagents.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Mod: skins for the transcript: themed tool rows, reply gutters and spinner words; /skin swaps them live.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: Mod: IDE-style file tree that shows what Claude is doing and where in files.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Mod: keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and warns once before a cold send.

plugins.name: session-band
plugins.description: Mod: band above the prompt with turn, speed, cost, prompt cache countdown and context; notifies before the cache expires.

plugins.name: clawpit
plugins.description: Mod: an instrument panel above the prompt and a crew pane beside it, for the Claude Code desktop app.

plugins.name: clawpit-gauges
plugins.description: Mod: clawpit's gauges above the prompt without the Agents pane: context, the 5-hour and 7-day limits and session cost.
